# Fixture for the `proj.rust-target` rule, loaded into a FakeFs below the
# test home `/Users/Tester`. One entry per line: `<kind> <age-days> <path>`,
# kind `d` (directory), `f` (file, 8 blocks) or `l` (symlink); age is mtime
# before "now".
#
# Inactive project (90 days): its target is the only expected item. The
# target nested inside it (a crate vendored in the build output) is never
# listed on its own.
d 90 code
d 90 code/old
f 90 code/old/Cargo.toml
f 90 code/old/main.rs
d 90 code/old/target
f 90 code/old/target/app
d 90 code/old/target/vendored
f 90 code/old/target/vendored/Cargo.toml
d 90 code/old/target/vendored/target
f 90 code/old/target/vendored/target/lib
# Recent project (2 days): ignored.
d 2 code/recent
f 2 code/recent/Cargo.toml
d 90 code/recent/target
f 90 code/recent/target/app
# target with no Cargo.toml beside it: ignored.
d 90 code/orphan
f 90 code/orphan/readme.md
d 90 code/orphan/target
f 90 code/orphan/target/app
# Cargo.toml that is a symlink: ignored.
d 90 code/linked
l 90 code/linked/Cargo.toml
d 90 code/linked/target
f 90 code/linked/target/app
# Old project under a protected path: never entered.
d 90 Documents
d 90 Documents/proj
f 90 Documents/proj/Cargo.toml
d 90 Documents/proj/target
f 90 Documents/proj/target/app
